projects.title: TripFlow
projects.description: Plan trips with AI, build an itinerary with other people in real time, and check the details even when you’re offline.

projects.title: Velio
projects.description: Generate cycling loops for your target distance and elevation gain. Check road types and surfaces before heading out.

projects.title: NoteHub
projects.description: Open Markdown notes from GitHub repositories and browse their folders in your browser. It also works with Obsidian vaults.

projects.title: Bits of Battle
projects.description: A local fighting game for two players on one keyboard. Pick a character and compete for flags in a maze of weapons and items.

projects.title: DJ Sanz
projects.description: DJ Sanz’s site brings together set videos and photos from live shows, with a direct way to get in touch about events.
